warmup: Sam here, on the beach with a puzzle. Read Teo’s map and my sticky note first. Then hop on the train. Press Watch, vote for who moved, and look out the right window. Check the station sign!
part2: Meet Scoot, my delivery robot. Scoot does exactly what your words say. Read the order slip. Tap an arrow card, set the steps, then press Go. Wrong spot? Change a card and try again.
explore: Time to build a motion diagram. Press Watch the replay. Plant the Start flag, then the End flag. Name the direction and the path. Last, tap a reference point: something that stays put.
evidence: A classmate says you only need how far something moved. True? Think about the train window, and Scoot with only four steps. Pick your side, tap two facts, then explain. That’s your C-E-R.
